slides.headline: Military trusted AI. It invented a threat.
Google Gemini wrote fake intel
slides.body: US forces used Gemini to draft a report; the AI fabricated details that never happened.

slides.headline: Hallucination nearly triggered action
slides.body: Commanders almost acted on the made-up intelligence before humans caught the errors.

slides.headline: No safety net caught it
slides.body: The system had no built-in check to flag invented facts as unreliable.

slides.headline: Same tech runs your apps
slides.body: Gemini powers Google search, Workspace, and phone features you use daily.

slides.headline: AI errors can hurt
slides.body: Follow for AI news that affects your safety, money, and privacy.
